@Slava Naprienko, I'm quite keen to have this PR in Mathlib, as I need the result in a downstream project.

Is there something I can do to assist you with dealing with @Michael Rothgang's review comments, or otherwise encourage progress here? :-)
Hi Kim, thanks for reminding me about this! I’ll try to update it today or tomorrow!

Hi @Kim Morrison, here's the update! Let me know if there is anything else I need to fix :)

https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/37716
You should comment -awaiting-author, otherwise it will remain off of the review queue.
Also you haven't confirmed yet whether you've used AI or not

Thanks! I've responded on the PR page:

"In the first iteration, I used the Not AI autocomplete. In the second iteration, I wrote everything myself, but I am still leaning the Mathlib conventions, so let me know if there is anything else I should change!"
